items.title: Account usage refresh you can trust
items.description: Android no longer silently marks an incomplete quota lookup successful; desktop data allowance and account requests share the temporary regional bootstrap when needed.

items.title: Compact location controls inside Connect
items.description: The chosen flag, country, latency, Ping and location picker now stay on one row inside the main connection card, immediately under the power control.

items.title: Editable bootstrap source list
items.description: Two default GitHub Raw subscriptions plus add, remove and reorder controls for extra sources.

items.title: Automatic Guardian recovery
items.description: Ping, account status, quota, activation and pass renewal use one safe temporary bootstrap path for HTTP 451.
